svg.title: pipeline: temperature, on-chip and off-chip, cell prep to library
svg.text: The whole pipeline: where it is cold, where it is hot, and the one step that cycles
protocols/thermal_map.md · chips: chip/module1_v1, module4_v1, module5_v1 · temperatures in °C, time not to scale
Index PCR in module 4 is the ONLY thermocycling step. Every other stage is a constant-temperature hold.
Culture cannot share a chip with anything after it: everything from room temperature onward kills cells, so modules 1–3 stay at or below 37 °C.
The thermocycler is off-chip hardware pressed against module 4, and is optional: the PCR can move to tubes (module4_v1.json). SPRI size selection stays in a tube.
Module 5 releases with collagenase at 37 °C (chip/module5_v1.json). Proteinase K does not open these capsules, so step 16 needs no heat beyond an incubator.
Unconfirmed: if the RT and template-switch step is a stepped ramp like SPLiT-seq, that one counts as cycled too (thermal_map.md, 3c).
